title: Summit Club Reduction on Summit Miles Upgrade Co-Pays
content:
**Question: does a Summit Club lounge membership lower the co-pay of a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program miles upgrade?**

Yes. The reduction follows the member's Summit Club membership under the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships charter, as its product and status show on its record.

| Summit Club membership | Status | Taken off (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Executive, Summit Club Corporate or Summit Club Lifetime | Active | 15 |
| Summit Club Essential, Summit Club Individual or Summit Club Individual Plus | Active | 7.5 |
| No active Summit Club membership | | None |

**Question: from what is it taken off?** From the co-pay to charge; it never takes the co-pay to charge below zero.

**Question: does an expired Executive membership count?** No; the membership must be active.

**Hypothetical figures.** A co-pay of 56.25 USD falls to 41.25 USD with an active Summit Club Lifetime membership and to 48.75 USD with an active Summit Club Essential membership.
